fusions.name: Brooding Hush
fusions.desc: Exhales a warm cloud in a cone 4 tiles long that deals 10 damage to everything in it and knocks it back 2 tiles. Each has a 50% chance to be [Damped] for 6 seconds, its damage lowered.

fusions.name: Quiet Mouthful
fusions.desc: Snaps up a mouthful for 5 damage, up to 1.3 times that at its full 3 tiles, and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Huddle Up
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you and every ally for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Forage
fusions.desc: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
